memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: "Neither do people light a lamp and put it under a bowl. Instead they put it on its stand, and it gives light to everyone in the house." — Matthew 5:15

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
Jesus clearly stated that a light is meant to be seen. It is placed on a lampstand to serve a purpose to illuminate the household. As followers of Christ, He has declared, "You are the light of the world." We are called to glow like a powerful lighthouse, piercing through the darkness to show the weary traveler the direction of the shore.
​However, there is a danger of "slowing down" or growing weak in our spiritual radiance. When our glow fades, people can no longer find the direction they need through us. Apostle Paul recognized this risk when he encouraged young Timothy to "kindle the flame" of the gift of faith which was given through the laying on of hands.
​We, too, carry a divine anointing to be a light. But a flame needs oxygen and fuel to stay bright. Our spiritual glow is maintained and brightened through a consistent prayer life and the fresh oil of the Holy Anointing. Don't let your light grow dim; keep the fire burning through your intimacy with God.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: "A lamp doesn't speak; it simply shines. A lighthouse doesn't ring a bell; it just glows."

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Heavenly Father, thank You for calling me to be a light in this dark world. Forgive me for the times I have allowed my flame to grow dim. Today, I ask for a fresh anointing of Your Holy Spirit to kindle the fire of faith within me. Let my life be a lighthouse that leads others to Your grace. May my prayer life be the fuel that keeps me glowing for Your glory. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: Your prayer life is the thermostat of your spiritual glow. If you feel your light is fading, spend time in His presence today and watch the flame rise again!
